subject.title: Telegram: collapse mid-paragraph newlines before sending

question: Should Telegram soft hard-wrap collapse be a default behavior, an opt-in channel setting, or rejected in favor of preserving authored line breaks?
rationale: The current code deliberately preserves or materializes line breaks for related rich-message fixes, while this request asks for the opposite behavior for prose hard-wraps and may require new public config.

options.title: Add opt-in collapse setting
options.body: Implement a Telegram setting that collapses safe prose/list hard-wraps while leaving existing default newline preservation unchanged.

options.title: Make collapse default
options.body: Normalize Telegram prose hard-wraps by default, accepting the compatibility risk for users who intentionally rely on single newlines.

options.title: Keep preservation policy
options.body: Close or defer this request and keep Telegram output faithful to model-authored line breaks.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in collapse setting
recommendation.body: Implement a Telegram setting that collapses safe prose/list hard-wraps while leaving existing default newline preservation unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight recently changed the same Telegram rich line-break policy path and has the clearest direct history for the current formatter behavior.
